svg.title: Five Revenue Rails, One $535,000 Base
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-five-operator-revenue-rails; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Five Revenue Rails, One $535,000 Base; subtitle: Illustrative annual dollar yield by sub-niche, not asset investment returns; chapter number: 2; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Bar values are annual operator-revenue contributions in USD, not percentage yields or underlying asset prices. Deal counts and unit spreads are illustrative allocations of the canonical Base total. The eight IOS yards each contribute twelve months of retained spread in this mature-year model.; caption: Scenario anchors remain Conservative $120,000 revenue at 28% for $33,600 owner profit; Base $535,000 at 40.0% for $214,000; Scaled $950,000 at 52% for $494,000. Conservative and Base use four people; Scaled uses six.; stages: label: Ground-tower easement spreads; value: 2 transactions × $75,000; numeric value: 150000.0; detail: Retain $150,000 after the modeled acquisition consideration embedded in each buyout spread, before the waterfall's separate operating expenses. Collect through documented settlement disbursements rather than counting buyer principal.; label: Rooftop telecom rights spreads; value: 2 transactions × $55,000; numeric value: 110000.0; detail: Retain $110,000 from transferable rooftop rights. Price roof replacement access, relocation provisions, building lender consent, and operator termination rights before accepting the acquisition obligation.; label: Digital-billboard assignments; value: 5 assignments × $19,000; numeric value: 95000.0; detail: Earn $95,000 in documented assignment fees for usable ground-control packages. Verify permit transfer procedures and lease consent separately; traffic volume does not establish transferable sign rights.; label: Fleet drop-yard master leases; value: 4 yards × $25,000 annually; numeric value: 100000.0; detail: Retain $100,000 after master rent and directly allocated property obligations. Bill fleet tenants through authorized ACH instructions and reconcile settled receipts against contract schedules and access records.; label: Equipment-storage master leases; value: 4 yards × $20,000 annually; numeric value: 80000.0; detail: Retain $80,000 after master rent and directly allocated property obligations. Monitor permitted storage categories, surface damage, delinquency, and exposure to uninsured tenant equipment losses.

circle.title: label: Ground-tower easement spreads; value: 2 transactions × $75,000; numeric value: 150000.0; detail: Retain $150,000 after the modeled acquisition consideration embedded in each buyout spread, before the waterfall's separate operating expenses. Collect through documented settlement disbursements rather than counting buyer principal.

label: Rooftop telecom rights spreads; value: 2 transactions × $55,000; numeric value: 110000.0; detail: Retain $110,000 from transferable rooftop rights. Price roof replacement access, relocation provisions, building lender consent, and operator termination rights before accepting the acquisition obligation.

label: Digital-billboard assignments; value: 5 assignments × $19,000; numeric value: 95000.0; detail: Earn $95,000 in documented assignment fees for usable ground-control packages. Verify permit transfer procedures and lease consent separately; traffic volume does not establish transferable sign rights.

label: Fleet drop-yard master leases; value: 4 yards × $25,000 annually; numeric value: 100000.0; detail: Retain $100,000 after master rent and directly allocated property obligations. Bill fleet tenants through authorized ACH instructions and reconcile settled receipts against contract schedules and access records.

label: Equipment-storage master leases; value: 4 yards × $20,000 annually; numeric value: 80000.0; detail: Retain $80,000 after master rent and directly allocated property obligations. Monitor permitted storage categories, surface damage, delinquency, and exposure to uninsured tenant equipment losses.

text.title: Assumptions: Bar values are annual operator-revenue contributions in USD, not percentage yields or underlying asset prices. Deal counts and unit spreads are illustrative allocations of the canonical Base total. The eight IOS yards each contribute twelve months of retained spread in this mature-year model.
